MSCI India Index Rejig: Stocks Added and Removed

MSCI has announced its August rejig for the MSCI India Index, resulting in the addition of four Indian stocks and the removal of three. Adani Energy Solutions and Lenskart Solutions are among the new additions. SBI Cards and Payment Services Ltd. and Astral Ltd. are among those being removed. Following the changes, the total number of Indian constituents in the MSCI index will increase to 166 from 165. Astral Ltd. and Balkrishna Industries Ltd. will be moved to the MSCI India Smallcap Index.
